hints: Look closely at the side chain on the polymer backbone and spot the functional group present in every repeat unit.
Notice that each repeat unit contains a $\text{CO}_2\text{CH}_3$ group, which is a methyl ester.
Recall which two conditions hydrolyse esters, and ask yourself if an ester has any acidic H to react with sodium metal.
walkthrough:
**Identify the functional group in polymer X**

Look at the repeating side chain. Every other carbon carries $\text{CO}_2\text{CH}_3$.

This is an ester group, $\text{-COOCH}_3$:
$$\text{-C(=O)-O-CH}_3$$

**Recall how esters react with aqueous acid and alkali**

Esters undergo hydrolysis when heated with water in acid or alkaline conditions.

Acid hydrolysis gives carboxylic acid + alcohol:
$$\text{RCOOR' + H}_2\text{O} \xrightarrow{\text{H}^+} \text{RCOOH + R'OH}$$

Base hydrolysis gives carboxylate salt + alcohol:
$$\text{RCOOR' + NaOH} \rightarrow \text{RCOO}^-\text{Na}^+ + \text{R'OH}$$

**Check reaction with sodium metal**

Sodium reacts with groups containing acidic hydrogen, such as $\text{-OH}$ and $\text{-COOH}$, to give $\text{H}_2$.

Polymer X has only ester groups and hydrocarbon backbone. There is no $\text{-OH}$ or $\text{-COOH}$, so no reaction with Na occurs. Therefore 1 and 2 react, but 3 does not.

options.A: Incorrect because it includes all three reagents. Statements 1 and 2 are correct as acid and base both hydrolyse the methyl ester side chains, but 3 is wrong as there is no -OH or -COOH for sodium to react with.
options.B: Correct because only 1 and 2 react. Aqueous sulfuric acid gives acid hydrolysis to -COOH + methanol, and aqueous NaOH gives base hydrolysis to -COO- Na+ + methanol. Sodium does not react with an ester.
options.C: Incorrect because it includes 3 and omits 1. Sodium does not react with esters, while aqueous sulfuric acid definitely does hydrolyse the ester side chains.
options.D: Incorrect because it includes only 1. Aqueous sulfuric acid does hydrolyse the ester, but aqueous sodium hydroxide also hydrolyses it by base hydrolysis, so 2 must also be included.
